PLAY-REC-D268-270-TRAVEL-001
Player said 'Continue the journey' at dawn Day268 after previously accepted wolf encounter, successful intimidation and qualifying wilderness overnight. On the established Crownsunder→legal western Veyr commercial road with V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar, intact coach and 4 healthy horses, ordinary daytime travel continues. Encounter-protection rule: Day266 trolls and Day267 wolves were two consecutive random encounter DAYS, so Day268 is a mandatory random-encounter quiet travel day, no Day268 day or night roll. Day268→269 roadside wilderness overnight peacefully completed and adds1 weighted Long Rest unit1/6→2/6; normal wilderness Short Rest completes for all, no HP/HD/spells/limited features spent. Day269 dawn normal once-per-day feeding for three eaters Mara/Cirren/Fenar and four horses: rations12→9 person-days, horse feed16→12 animal-days. Day269 ordinary trade-road daytime d100 FACE47 vs01–15 NO encounter; following exposed wilderness camp night d100 FACE35 vs01–07 NO encounter; genuine Python secrets executed both. Peaceful qualifying night269→270 completes wilderness Short Rest and weighted Long Rest2/6→3/6; no feature/spell/HP/HD changes beyond already-full Short Rest pools, no full Long Rest. Day270 dawn normal breakfast/feed one allocation: rations9→6, horse feed12→8. Day270 daytime ordinary road encounter d100 FACE80 vs01–15 NO encounter (genuine executed Python secrets). Late Day270 afternoon while still in Crownsunder and still before legal western Veyr crossing, party passes scattered low hills/farms and sees a small inhabited commercial road-side service settlement ahead, cluster of slate roofs, fenced wagon yard and stable signs. Exact official name, distance to frontier and whether a secure town rest applies are NOT established until actual arrival; no specific resident met, trade, fee, toll, purchase, border, accommodation or road arrival assumed. Coach/horses intact, V HP48/48 HD5/7 SecondWind1/1, Superiority4/4 ActionSurge1/1, Psi6/6 MP7/7, Fenar58/59 HD1/6 Rage2/4 Shift1/3, Cirren49/51 HD5/6 L1=0/4 L2=1/3 L3=2/3, Channel Divinity2/2. Long Rest progress3/6. Supplies now6 ration-person-days and8 horse-feed animal-days (two days at established daily rates). Late-afternoon Day270 next V choice: approach and resupply or lodge at settlement, continue along main road or otherwise; no new day/night check or rest yet. No unrelated quest event, initiative or treasure.

PLAY-REC-D270-ROADVILLAGE-RESUPPLY-001
Player exact response at Day270 late-afternoon roadside settlement: "yes and resupply", accepting offer to stop for provisions and lodging. Party V, Mara, Cirren, Fenar enters an ordinary unnamed small permanently occupied Crownsunder trade-road village short of western Veyr crossing with shop, smith and staffed coaching inn/stables. No invented border arrival, new named NPC, quest or extraordinary merchant roll. Established V travel-provision targets are seven days for three eaters and four horses; before resupply carried six ration-person-days, eight horse-feed animal-days. Mundane supplies purchased: 15 ration-person-days at 5sp each=7gp5sp; 20 horse-feed animal-days at5cp each=1gp; goods now 21 ration-person-days and28 feed animal-days. User accepted overnight lodging as well: four modest beds at standard5sp each=2gp and one night's stabling for four horses at5sp each=2gp; two modest rooms arranged, staff takes ordinary custody/care of four healthy V horses, V coach parked in serviced yard, still V-owned. Purchase plus accommodation cost total12gp5sp, paid V personal purse once: 1150gp2sp6cp ->1137gp7sp6cp. No payment by estate or NPC. Mundane staff arrange goods and horses without special check, no extra magical purchase or inn meal charge; ordinary evening local elapsed time only, no overnight Short Rest or full Long Rest yet, no day271 supplies allocation, spell or HP restoration, and no encounter roll. V48/48 HP HD5/7 ActionSurge1/1 Superiority4/4 SecondWind1/1 Psi6/6 MP7/7; Fenar58/59 HD1/6 Rage2/4 Shift1/3; Cirren49/51 HD5/6 L1=0/4 L2=1/3 L3=2/3. Long Rest progress3/6 unchanged pending a qualifying quiet overnight. Player controls whether to retire, talk to companions, ask locals, or depart later.

PLAY-REC-D270-273-REST-ROAD-001
Player exact instruction after Day270 early evening inn and completed seven-day mundane resupply: "yep continue", affirming retiring for paid night and resuming ordinary coach travel toward legal western Veyr crossing. At DAY270 evening at permanent inhabited small road village in Crownsunder, two modest paid rooms and stable are genuinely sheltered and secure. Quiet overnight Day270->271 counts +2 weighted Long Rest units under town rule, previous progress3/6->5/6. No exposed nighttime encounter roll in genuinely secured settlement. Overnight Short Rest completes for V and allies, but no HD spent (V HP48/48; Fenar58/59 elects to conserve last HD1/6, Cirren49/51 elects to conserve HD5/6); no spell/Psi/Rage restoration before full Long Rest. DAY271 morning consumed 3 ration-person-days and 4 horse-feed animal-days once: 21->18 and28->24. Four healthy horses and intact coach depart town, owner purse remains1137gp7sp6cp with no extra lodging/toll/other purchase. DAY271 ordinary Crownsunder trade road daytime encounter genuine Python secrets d100 FACE51 vs01–15 = no encounter. Day271 exposed wilderness roadside night genuine d100 FACE63 vs01–07 = no encounter; quiet camp/night qualifies Short Rest and sixth continuous weighted Long Rest unit5->6/6 at DAWN272, completes Long Rest exactly once. Full Long Rest restores V full HP48/48, Fighter/Rogue HD5/7->7/7 (up to floor(7/2)=3 restored, only two missing), all V finite Long Rest features full (Psi6/6, PastLife3/3), Short Rest full (SecondWind1/1, ActionSurge1/1, Superiority4/4, MP7/7); Fenar HP58/59->59/59, spent Rage restored2/4->4/4, Shift1/3->3/3, HD1/6->4/6 via up to half total Barbarian HD=3, MP6/6 full; Cirren HP49/51->51/51, L1=0/4->4/4, L2=1/3->3/3, L3=2/3->3/3, HD5/6->6/6, Channel Divinity2/2. Full rest completes previous LR chain, next chain starts0/6; no same-night double counting. DAY272 morning ration/feed once: 18->15 person-days and24->20 feed animal-days. Day272 daytime encounter genuine secrets d100 FACE18 vs01–15 = no event. Day272 exposed wilderness night d100 FACE56 vs01–07 = no event, peaceful qualifying wilderness night, new weighted Long Rest chain0->1/6 at DAWN273, Short Rest completes with no expenditure/HD needed. DAY273 morning ratio/feed once: 15->12 ration-person-days and20->16 animal-feed days, carriage and all four owned horses healthy, no new personal coin charge. Day273 daytime travel encounter genuine secrets d100 FACE48 vs01–15 = no event. By Day273 late afternoon party approaches visible operated LEGAL Crownsunder-to-western Veyr commercial crossing on established Tarnford–Caer Veylan trade-road route. Not yet entered or paid a toll or subject to inspection; date/position of crossing is newly established through actually elapsed travel, no fixed surveyed mileage or spurious name. Veyr signage/Primordial/Crownsunder trade traffic and ordinary officials consistent with world/politics/veyr-regional-security.md. Checkpoint officers/clerks have not yet spoken or acted on V's coach; no V speech/identity declarations/inspection, confiscation or legal fee fabricated. No new quest, destination arrival, Day273 night roll or Day274 incident. Companion resources full as above; Long Rest1/6, remaining rations12/feed16, purse1137gp7sp6cp.
pending_action: Day273 late afternoon, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar in intact four-horse enclosed coach have come within sight of functioning legal Crownsunder–western Veyr commercial surface crossing on established Tarnford–Caer Veylan road. Haven't presented documents, spoken to border officials, paid any fee, or entered Veyr. V48/48 HP HD7/7 SecondWind1/1 ActionSurge1/1 Superiority4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7; Fenar59/59 HD4/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3; Cirren51/51 HD6/6 slots L1 4/4 L2 3/3 L3 3/3. Four horses healthy, coach sound, supplies12 ration-person-days and16 feed animal-days, purse1137gp7sp6cp. Full LR finished dawn272; new LR progress1/6 at dawn273. Day273 night not yet rolled; V next action or ordinary presentation at border pending. No Day274 scheduled event activated.
